acts.desc: Evan Harris was entrenched in her life, stalled and going nowhere both personally and professionally. A silly conversation with a co-worker about the letter "Q" led her to start a magazine called Quitter Quarterly. That one conversation changed her life completely.
acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc: A story about quitting by Sandra Tsing Loh.

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Ira explores the question of when it's time to quit a relationship through rare recordings of bickering between roommates—recorded by the next-door neighbors.

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Lisa Buscani reads a two-part story about not being able to quit something or someone. The piece was written for This American Life.

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc:
Dwight Okita reads the poem "Farewell Samba" from his book Crossing with the Light.
Ira Glass reads Philip Larkin 's poem "Poetry of Departures."
